ModMetaData.name: Homesteader
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Everything a growing homestead needs: tribal survival, farm-to-table crafting, storage, food preservation, and off-grid power.
TRIBAL SURVIVAL (no research) - Drying rack: jerky, dried produce, fruit leather, dried mushrooms, and pemmican without needing pemmican research. - Field crops, basic storage crates, barrels, and pallets.
PRIMITIVE HOMESTEAD - Curing rack and smokehouse for salted and smoked meat. - Hayloft and ingredient barrel for bulk farm storage. - Orchard trees (apple, cherry, sugar maple).
FARMSTEAD CRAFTING - Grain mill, butter churn, cheese press, pickling crock, and homestead hearth. - Dairy pipeline: skim cream → churn butter or press cheese. - Sugar for jam, porridge, and cider; butter for bread and flapjacks.
ORCHARD & APIARY - Apple and cherry trees: slow-growing, regrowing orchard fruit for cider, jam, and eating fresh. - Sugar maple: tap for maple sap and boil it into maple syrup at the hearth - then griddle flapjacks. - Beehives produce beeswax alongside honey; render it into slow-burning beeswax candles.
AROUND THE FARMHOUSE - Preserves shelf: beautiful display storage for jams, pickles, cheese, dairy, honey, and syrup. - Nesting box: a snug straw-lined bed for small animals. - Harvest maypole: a ribboned gathering spot colonists celebrate around.
RESEARCH & PROGRESSION - Primitive homestead, food preservation, farmstead crafting, homestead storage, brewing, comforts, and advanced homestead. - Root cellar (passive cool storage ≤5°C), large storage crate, jam cauldron, and wood-burning generator.
POWER - Compact battery, battery bank, advanced battery, ultratech battery, portable chemfuel generator.
Odyssey owners get salted and smoked fish recipes automatically.
Requires the Harmony mod (C# for root cellar cooling). Safe to add to a save. Before removing it, deconstruct the mod's buildings and use up or sell its items.
